leadSuiteChat.title: Log your contacts
leadSuiteChat.intro: Tell me the business, the channel, when and what you sent. I'll log it.
leadSuiteChat.example1: I messaged Inmobiliaria Sur on WhatsApp today at 3pm, I sent: Hi, I saw your site and can help you get more inquiries.
leadSuiteChat.example2: Yesterday I emailed Café Central offering a website redesign.
leadSuiteChat.example3: Inmobiliaria Sur replied, we have a meeting on Thursday.

permissions.label: Permissions:
permissions.title: How much can it do alone?
permissions.help: Choose which actions Leadtita runs without asking you.

hints.danger: Everything without asking, except sends to several leads.

danger.title: Turn on Danger mode
danger.intro: Leadtita will run every action without asking you to confirm.
danger.risk1: Sends single emails as soon as it drafts them. Sends to several leads (email or WhatsApp) are always shown for review.
danger.risk2: It can spend all your credits on searches without asking.
danger.risk3: Deletes contacts and books meetings directly. Sent or deleted items can't be undone.
